classes.name: Βουλευτικές εκλογές
classes.finest_note: The ministry counts votes by polling station (εκλογικό τμήμα) and publishes them by constituency, municipality, municipal unit, and polling station; polling stations have no mapped boundaries.
classes.note: 300 seats: constituency seats in multi- and single-member constituencies plus a nationwide state list (Επικρατείας); reinforced proportional representation with a majority bonus except in May 2023 (simple proportional, law 4406/2016). Law 5285/2026 adds a three-seat constituency of Greeks abroad from the next general election.

cadence.vacancy_rule: Constitution art. 53: four-year term; early dissolution under arts. 32 and 41; a vacant constituency seat goes to the next candidate on the list, so by-elections are not held.

access.evidence: The ministry's results site and its archive of earlier elections (ekloges-prev.singularlogic.eu) refused this session (Akamai 403); results volumes for 2009, May and June 2012, and May 2023 sit on www.ypes.gr as PDF.
Printed results volumes by constituency, municipality, and polling station; www.ypes.gr refused this session (Akamai 403).

classes.name: Δημοτικά και περιφερειακά δημοψηφίσματα
classes.note: Provided for by the local government code; the ministry's results site lists no local referendum.
classes.disposition_reason: Law 3852/2010 provides for municipal and regional referendums, but no official results of any have been published; the ministry's results site lists none.

classes.name: Ιερά Κοινότητα Αγίου Όρους
classes.disposition_reason: Constitution art. 105: Mount Athos is self-governed by its twenty monasteries through representatives each monastery appoints to the Holy Community; no electorate votes.

classes.name: Δικαστικοί λειτουργοί
classes.disposition_reason: Constitution arts. 88 and 90: judges are career magistrates appointed by presidential decree; the top courts' presidents are chosen by the cabinet. No judicial office is elected.

classes.name: Εσωκομματικές εκλογές αρχηγού
classes.name_en: Party leadership and candidate selection contests
classes.disposition_reason: Leadership elections and open primaries (New Democracy, SYRIZA, PASOK) are run and counted by the parties under their own statutes; the state runs no nominating contest.

classes.name: Εκλογές επιμελητηρίων, συλλόγων, πανεπιστημίων και ΣΑΕ
classes.name_en: Chamber, professional, university, union, and diaspora council elections
classes.disposition_reason: Run by the bodies themselves for their members (chambers of commerce, bar associations, the Technical Chamber, universities, trade unions, the Council of Hellenes Abroad, and land-improvement organizations); no state authority certifies them for a territorial electorate.

classes.name: Έμμεσες εκλογές οργάνων
classes.disposition_reason: The Speaker and officers of Parliament, the prime minister's investiture, and the boards of the local government associations (KEDE, ENPE) are chosen by sitting members; their votes are recorded in minutes, not as public elections.
